LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Title: Establishing commercial contact
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.QuestDescription: The megacorporation's client relations department wishes to introduce its commercial network. Once the courier's handover report has been archived, a representative will visit within about two days to discuss the earlier courier contact, the Mugirls, and a goodwill gift.\n\nWhen the representative arrives, select a colonist who can speak and right-click the visitor to talk. No communications console is needed to complete this chapter. Accepting commercial contact unlocks both console and settlement terminals.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.QuestProgress: The client relations representative waits at a safe player colony. If the representative has not arrived yet, the quest shows the estimated time of arrival. The contact request remains active if talks are postponed or the representative departs or suffers an accident. Watch for another visit.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.QuestProgressWait: The transport handover report is still moving between departments. Client relations expects to send a representative in {0}.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.ArrivalText: {0} arrives carrying a slim folder, introducing themselves as a megacorporate client relations representative. They say the transport case file only recently landed on their desk - and they booked passage the same evening.\n\nSelect a colonist who can speak, right-click the representative and choose "Talk to corporate representative". Your Mugirls will not be reclaimed.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Opening: "Good day. Forgive the dust - the landing site was farther out than the file claimed." The visitor brushes ash from a sleeve and offers a measured smile. "Client relations. I read the transport handover report word by word. Halfway through, I nearly applied for a courier's license myself. A joke - mostly. I'm here to turn that page for the company, and talk about something worth talking about."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.OpeningOldSave: "Good day. We are completing the client register for this region - in plain speech, headquarters has only recently admitted that this wilderness deserves an account manager." A faint smile. "Whatever happened with transport is closed as of today. I brought contracts, not a summons."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.OpeningLong: "This formal visit is genuinely late. The fault is mine - and that of a file that spent a season touring four departments." He exhales. "That is how the machine works: the paperwork travels, the client waits. Someone finally fished yours out of the 'pending' pile. That someone was me. So - let us make up the lost time."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.OpeningLate: "While archiving this region's records, we discovered how long your colony has stood - and that we had never once come to call." He spreads his hands. "Discourteous; no argument here. Consider the supplies an apology. Think of us as the neighbor who arrived late: late, yes, but carrying gifts and honest intentions."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Reaction.Killed: "Transport has closed the courier's file. I signed for the form myself - it was economical with paper." He is quiet for a moment. "I am not here to assign blame. The company did not send me for the dead; it sent me for the living, and the business they can still do. A personal remark, if you allow it: I would prefer our first contract not come with a second obituary attached."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Reaction.DeadUnkno: "The last thing we received was his locator beacon. After that - nothing. The rescue clause paid for a single flyover." The envoy closes the terminal in his hands. "The wilderness takes no sides. It was not your fault, and it does not have to be anyone's. I am here so that the next person walking this route has somewhere safe to stop."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Reaction.Released: "He made it back alive and filed the report himself. There is a line in it - 'the colony showed restraint.' Between us, that sentence saved his quarterly review and spared me a page of incident paperwork." A rare, brief smile. "You let him leave with his dignity. I noticed. I remember things like that."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Reaction.Conflict: "I have read the field reports. Both sides fired; as to who fired first, the two accounts disagree." He waves a hand. "Keep it. That ledger is a mess. He signed the risk clause, and so did I. Today I speak for client relations, not for collections."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Reaction.Unresolve: "Transport says the handover is 'still in progress.' Translated: his terminal has not pinged in three days." A pause. "Do not misunderstand - I am not here to press. If he is still on your land, he is still alive, and that matters more than any report. Let us handle business. He can finish his own paperwork."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Reaction.Unknown: "Of that contact, I hold half a page of records - transport's servers apparently kept the other half." A shrug. "It does not matter. Old accounts belong to audit. New friends belong to me."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.KeepMugirl: "As for the Mugirls - keep them. The company does not deal in losses, and it does not deal in ruin." He glances toward the pasture. "A herd well kept is worth far more than a herd locked away. That is arithmetic we can both agree on."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.NoReclaim: "Repossess old assets? That is collections' job, and they are welcome to the paperwork." A rare, dry joke. "Client relations keeps one rule: settle the accounts, but never drive people into the dirt. Where the Mugirls live does not concern the company. How well they live - that is what moves the buying price."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Proposal: "A goodwill gift from client relations - in writing, no trap clauses." He sets a data pad on the table. "Purchasing, supply, personnel, financing: four lines of business, all open to your colony. You need not answer today. Trust is negotiated slowly, and so is good business - the forms never teach that part."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Question.Courier: Why overlook what happened to the courier?
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Question.Mugirl: Why let us keep the Mugirls?
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Question.Services: What services does the corporation offer?
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Answer.Courier: "You ask why the company looks away?" A thin smile. "There are five thousand couriers. A client like you - one per planet, if that. That is arithmetic, not forgiveness. Forgiveness is not my department. Arithmetic, however, I do well."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Answer.Mugirl: "Chains can lock up output; they cannot lock up the creatures producing it - my former supervisor said that. He was optimized out of the company; the words survived." A glance toward the pasture. "Well-fed Mugirls produce more, and the buying price grows friendlier. Look at it this way: treating them well is the cheapest contract either of us will ever sign."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Answer.Services: "In plain terms: you produce, we buy everything. You run short, we restock weekly. Special orders can be placed, hands can be hired, money can be borrowed against collateral." He counts on his fingers. "The contract center handles manufacturing, elimination, investment and distribution. Every term is in writing before you sign. The first rule they taught me: a client who reads the fine print stays a client."
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Accept: Accept the gift and establish commercial contact.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.Postpone: Leave the information. I will think it over.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.CompletedLetter:
Corporate client relations has registered your colony as a commercial client. Delivery of the goodwill gift has been arranged. If no delivery location is available, supplies are held until delivery becomes possible.

Order a colonist to use a communications console and select "Contact the corporate network", or stop a caravan at a corporate settlement and open its "Corporate terminal". Further business will proceed under contract.

The first story chapter is complete. Further chapters: coming soon.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.HostilityRemains: Separate diplomatic disputes remain. Opening this account does not erase hostilities resulting from attacks against the corporation. New business remains restricted until relations are repaired; account access and repayment remain available.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CorporateIntro.ChapterCompleted:
Client registration: complete.
Transport case: archived; no recovery ordered.

Client relations looks forward to a profitable partnership.
